source_version: CCC 2024 LIPIcs 300 article 4; published 2024-07-15; official 20-page PDF
title: Catalytic search for a common accepting input of dense read-once branching programs

standard_prerequisites.name: Nisan pairwise-independent hash mixing and hybrid-generator bound; canonicalizer specialization of Putterman-Pyne
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Original Lemmas 22,29,31 and bibliography [16],[19]; author local proofs/translations of Lemmas 15,21 and Proposition25 included.

core_obligations: Construct hash functions simultaneously good for every branching program by conditional catalytic compression.
Search the small generator domain and restore the catalytic tape after returning a common accepting input.
difficulty_reason: Constructs a common Nisan generator by conditional compression of bad hash functions, uses a single generator for a family of programs and reversibly restores the catalytic tape after extracting a common accepting input. The complete compression/decompression construction and source-local appendix proofs are retained.

dedup.scope: Root checked the complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active production lines for exclusive DOI before allocation with zero neighbors. Mutual ROBP hitting is a search conclusion; stochastic matrix powering is a numerical derandomization conclusion. Shared conditional compression supports both and is not separately counted. ECCC and later journal aliases retained.
